title: Tanzanian Lamb Chops
community: Urban Tanzania — hotel and restaurant favourite
author: Chef Jabir
desc: Tanzanian Ghafi za Kondoo — lamb chops marinated in a paste of Zanzibar spices, garlic, and lemon, grilled over charcoal or in a pan until magnificently charred with a blushing medium-rare interior. Tanzania's hotel restaurant luxury lamb dish.
longDesc: Lamb chops at a Tanzanian hotel restaurant represent the meeting of global fine dining with Zanzibar's extraordinary spice tradition — the marinade is uniquely Tanzanian, the technique is international, and the result is completely world-class.
steps: Mix all marinade into a smooth paste.
Heat grill pan or charcoal to very high.
Grill chops 3—4 minutes per side for medium-rare.
chefTips: Very high heat — lamb chops must be seared, not steamed.
culturalNote: Zanzibar-spiced lamb chops represent Tanzania's fine dining ambition — taking the world's great dining tradition and infusing it with the spice heritage of the Indian Ocean's greatest spice island.
